name: micro-tools-matrix
description: A zero-dependency TypeScript utility library with micro-tools for everyday tasks

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --declaration --declarationDir dist/types --emitDeclarationOnly --moduleResolution node && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --outDir dist/esm --declaration false --emitDeclarationOnly false && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --outDir dist/cjs --declaration false --emitDeclarationOnly false && node scripts/fix-cjs.cjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run test

author: chleya
